Test in an Incognito / Private Window: Open an Incognito window and paste the link: Plaintext https://saptarshigoswami1.github.io/Portfolio/ 2. It must be named exactly: Plaintext index.html (All lowercase, no spaces, no .txt or .html.html at the end). 4. Check the Actions Tab for Errors Click the Actions tab at the top of your GitHub page. You should see a workflow titled pages-build-deployment. If it has a green checkmark (✓), the files were successfully processed. Opens in a new window প্ৰত্যাশা | PRATYAKHYA | A Short Film on Exam Pressure & Expectations SG PRODUCTIONS Opens in a new window In a country where marks often define worth, PRATYAKHA tells the story of a young student awaiting the result of a competitive exam after multiple attempts. As the day unfolds, the weight of parental expectations and societal pressure grows heavier than the result itself. Caught between hope and fear, silence and disappointment, he faces an internal battle that many students experience but rarely speak about. This short film is a reflection on academic pressure, parental sacrifice, and the emotional struggles hidden behind results. Technical Competencies

The Creative & Technical Pillars

Bridging 11+ years of post-production discipline with active directorial storytelling and fast-reaction camera operation.

01 // Post & Color Precision

11+ Years Editing Discipline

Ultra-fast color grading and finishing calibrated for difficult lighting. Skilled in salvaging skin tones under blinding stage gels, balancing dynamic ranges, and delivering broadcast-ready color fidelity.

02 // Cinematic Narrative

Directorial Vision & Drama

Director of 3 original short films (Ekhon Nedekha Nodir Xipare, PRATYAKHA, and MOI) and 1 upcoming feature film. Understands dramatic rhythm, spatial blocking, and emotional nuance.

03 // High-Speed Reaction

Kinetic Tracking & Low Light

Trained on unpredictable wildlife action in harsh terrain and applied directly to live arena pits. Confident autofocus tracking for sprint strides, drumstick velocity, and unscripted performer movement.

Production Workflow

Tour & Festival Delivery Standards

Engineered for high-tempo music tours, festivals, and press desks. Strict adherence to pit safety etiquette (no-flash rule, non-intrusive stage presence) coupled with rapid turnaround delivery.

  • Night-of Selects 5–10 High-Res Hero Frames within 2 Hours

    Color-graded teaser files delivered before midnight for instant artist PR, Instagram, and press distribution.

  • Complete Archive Master Gallery Delivered in 48 Hours

    Comprehensive high-resolution catalog covering close-up portraits, wide-angle venue scale, stage pyrotechnics, and backstage candid life.

Booking & Availability

Commission a Project or Tour

Available for film direction, concert pit credentials, festival coverage, and narrative film cinematography across Assam and pan-India.
